caption: Doge's Palace, Venice
composition: Gothic façade and colonnade on the Bacino · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The palace is seen from the waterfront promenade along the Bacino, its long façade running diagonally across the frame. The pink-and-white diamond-patterned upper wall sits above two tiers of Gothic arcades, their columns reflected in the wet paving at the water's edge. To the right the grey water of the Bacino opens out with mooring poles, and the campanile rises in the far distance. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 07:19 Europe/Rome: overcast morning, soft diffused light and damp stone.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Doge's Palace in Venice under overcast morning light
